title: Rising Trend
subtitle: 本課限定語境：rising trend = a pattern in which a quantity, rate, level, behavior, or phenomenon
description: 本課限定語境：rising trend = a pattern in which a quantity, rate, level, behavior, or phenomenon is increasing over time · 「上升趨勢；增長趨勢；愈來愈明顯的傾向」

words.note: 表示某個數值、比率、價格、需求或指標隨時間向上。
words.example: The data show an upward trend in online sales.
words.exampleZh: 數據顯示網上銷售呈上升趨勢。

exercises.original: The chart shows a rising trend in house prices over the past five years.
exercises.zh: 圖表顯示過去五年樓價呈上升趨勢。
exercises.upgrade: The chart shows an upward trend in house prices over the past five years.

options.explanation: chart + over the past five years 明確是時間序列，而且整體方向向上，因此 upward trend 最直接。
只表示一次上升，無法涵蓋五年整體方向。
表示上下波動；即使數據有波動，也不能單憑此詞表示整體向上。
是最高點，而不是五年內的方向。
表示大致不變，和 rising 相反。

exercises.original: Sales figures have followed a rising trend since January.
exercises.zh: 自一月以來，銷售數字一直呈上升趨勢。
exercises.upgrade: Sales figures have followed an upward trend since January.

options.explanation: since January 表示一段持續時間，並且 rising 明確是向上方向。
isolated 表示單次事件，和持續趨勢不符。
peak 只是某一最高點，不表示整段期間一直上升。
隨機變化沒有一致方向。

exercises.original: The report identifies a rising trend in demand for electric vehicles.
exercises.zh: 報告指出電動車需求呈上升趨勢。
exercises.upgrade: The report identifies an upward trend in demand for electric vehicles.

options.explanation: demand + report + trend 是典型市場分析語境，upward trend 最自然。
只表示需求最高點，不表示持續增加。
可能只是短期上下變動。
一次性增長不足以構成 trend。

words.meaning: 增加趨勢；持續上升趨勢
words.note: 表示某項數值、活動或現象呈持續增加方向。
words.example: Researchers observed an increasing trend in average temperatures.
words.exampleZh: 研究人員觀察到平均氣溫持續上升的趨勢。

exercises.original: Researchers observed a rising trend in average summer temperatures.
exercises.zh: 研究人員觀察到夏季平均氣溫呈持續上升趨勢。
exercises.upgrade: Researchers observed an increasing trend in average summer temperatures.

options.explanation: researchers + average temperatures 表示研究數據隨時間增加，increasing trend 是正式自然表達。
只是一個觀察點上升，不足以稱 trend。
強調波動而非持續增加。

exercises.original: The survey found a rising trend in the number of employees working remotely.
exercises.zh: 調查發現遙距工作的員工數量呈增加趨勢。
exercises.upgrade: The survey found an increasing trend in the number of employees working remotely.

options.explanation: the number of employees 是量化數值，因此 increasing trend 最直接。
也有一定合理性，但 tendency 更適合說 a growing tendency for employees to work remotely；若保留 number of employees，trend 更自然。
最高點不等於增加趨勢。

exercises.original: Hospital data show a rising trend in admissions during the winter months.
exercises.zh: 醫院數據顯示冬季入院人數呈增加趨勢。
exercises.upgrade: Hospital data show an increasing trend in admissions during the winter months.

options.explanation: hospital data + admissions 是典型量化資料，表示數量愈來愈高。
spike 是突然一次急升，不代表整體 trend。

words.meaning: 愈來愈明顯的傾向；增長中的傾向
words.note: 表示人們愈來愈傾向某種行為、選擇或態度。
words.example: There is a growing tendency for consumers to shop online.
words.exampleZh: 消費者愈來愈傾向網上購物。

exercises.original: There is a rising trend for consumers to compare prices online before buying.
exercises.zh: 消費者購買前愈來愈傾向在網上比較價格。
exercises.upgrade: There is a growing tendency for consumers to compare prices online before buying.

options.explanation: for consumers to... 是典型 tendency 結構，表示愈來愈多人出現這種行為傾向。
更適合價格、指數等數值，不自然描述 consumer behavior。
fixed 表示穩定不變，沒有「愈來愈」含義。
人類行為趨勢不是單次事件。

exercises.original: Among younger workers, there is a rising trend toward flexible working hours.
exercises.zh: 年輕員工愈來愈傾向選擇彈性工作時間。
exercises.upgrade: Among younger workers, there is a growing tendency toward flexible working hours.

options.explanation: among younger workers + toward 描述群體偏好，tendency 比純數據 trend 更人本。
不自然修飾 preference toward working hours。

exercises.original: The study notes a rising trend among parents to limit children's screen time.
exercises.zh: 研究指出家長愈來愈傾向限制兒童使用屏幕的時間。
exercises.upgrade: The study notes a growing tendency among parents to limit children's screen time.

options.explanation: among parents to limit... 是典型人的行為傾向結構。
如果有父母人數的明確時間數據才適合；原句焦點是 behavioral tendency。

words.note: 表示一組資料、事件或行為呈現反覆且逐漸增加的規律。
words.example: The researchers found an increasing pattern of late-night screen use.
words.exampleZh: 研究人員發現深夜使用屏幕的情況呈逐步增加模式。

exercises.original: The data reveal a rising trend of late-night internet use among teenagers.
exercises.zh: 數據顯示青少年深夜使用互聯網呈逐步增加模式。
exercises.upgrade: The data reveal an increasing pattern of late-night internet use among teenagers.

options.explanation: data reveal + repeated behavior 表示資料中出現一個愈來愈常見的模式，pattern 很合適。
只是一個時點，不能構成 repeated pattern。
隨機變化沒有一致 increasing pattern。

exercises.original: Researchers noticed a rising trend in complaints after each software update.
exercises.zh: 研究人員注意到每次軟件更新後投訴呈逐步增加模式。
exercises.upgrade: Researchers noticed an increasing pattern in complaints after each software update.

options.explanation: after each software update 表示反覆觀察到同類增加，因此 pattern 比單次 rise 更精確。
isolated 和 each update 的重複性矛盾。
表示上升後持平，不是持續增加。

exercises.original: The figures show a rising trend of higher spending toward the end of each month.
exercises.zh: 數據顯示每逢月底消費呈逐步上升模式。
exercises.upgrade: The figures show an increasing pattern of spending toward the end of each month.

options.explanation: toward the end of each month 表示反覆出現的資料形態，increasing pattern 很適合。
peak 是最高點，不表示整段逐步增加。
不是單次，而是每月反覆。

words.note: 表示價格、指數、數值或其他指標向上移動。
words.example: The market showed upward movement after the announcement.
words.exampleZh: 公告後市場出現向上走勢。

exercises.original: Share prices showed a rising trend after the announcement.
exercises.zh: 公告後股價出現向上走勢。
exercises.upgrade: Share prices showed upward movement after the announcement.

options.explanation: share prices + after an announcement 常是市場短期走勢，upward movement 很自然。
表示價格沒有明顯變化。
表示到達最高點，不一定描述 announcement 後的整體向上移動。

exercises.original: The index continued its rising trend during morning trading.
exercises.zh: 指數在早市交易期間繼續向上移動。
exercises.upgrade: The index continued its upward movement during morning trading.

options.explanation: during morning trading 是短時間市場變動，movement 比 long-term trend 更貼切。
時間尺度過長；morning trading 只是一段短期市場時段。

exercises.original: Analysts noted a rising trend in the currency after the central bank statement.
exercises.zh: 央行聲明後，分析員注意到貨幣出現向上走勢。
exercises.upgrade: Analysts noted upward movement in the currency after the central bank statement.

options.explanation: currency + immediate reaction to a statement 是典型市場 movement 語境。
表示匯率固定，不是市場上升。

words.note: 表示某項數量、產業、人口、收入、需求或市場呈現增長方向。
words.example: The company expects the growth trend in demand to continue.
words.exampleZh: 公司預計需求的增長趨勢會持續。

exercises.original: The company expects the rising trend in online demand to continue next year.
exercises.zh: 公司預計網上需求的增長趨勢明年會持續。
exercises.upgrade: The company expects the growth trend in online demand to continue next year.

options.explanation: business forecast + demand + continue next year 明確是持續增長趨勢。
不能「continue next year」成為持續趨勢。
temporary peak 不代表增長方向會持續。
plateau 表示增長停止並持平。

exercises.original: The city has experienced a rising trend in population over the last decade.
exercises.zh: 這座城市過去十年人口呈增長趨勢。
exercises.upgrade: The city has experienced a growth trend in population over the last decade.

options.explanation: population + decade 是典型長期 demographic growth 語境。
十年時間範圍暗示多個觀察點，不是一次增長。

exercises.original: Investors are watching the rising trend in renewable-energy sales.
exercises.zh: 投資者正留意再生能源銷售的增長趨勢。
exercises.upgrade: Investors are watching the growth trend in renewable-energy sales.

options.explanation: sales + investors + sector analysis 是典型 business growth trend 語境。
是最高銷售點，不是整體增長方向。

words.meaning: 上升模式；逐漸上升的形態
words.note: 表示數據或現象呈現愈來愈高／多的模式。
words.example: The chart shows a rising pattern in electricity use during the evening.
words.exampleZh: 圖表顯示晚間用電量呈上升模式。

exercises.original: The graph shows a rising trend in electricity use from 6 p.m. to 9 p.m.
exercises.zh: 圖表顯示下午六時至九時用電量呈上升模式。
exercises.upgrade: The graph shows a rising pattern in electricity use from 6 p.m. to 9 p.m.

options.explanation: graph + ordered evening times 表示資料隨時間逐步提高，rising pattern 是自然描述。
只指單一最高點，不能描述 6–9 p.m. 整段上升。

exercises.original: The weekly figures reveal a rising trend in customer enquiries.
exercises.zh: 每週數據顯示客戶查詢呈上升模式。
exercises.upgrade: The weekly figures reveal a rising pattern in customer enquiries.

options.explanation: weekly figures 提供多個按時間排列的觀察值，呈現愈來愈高的 pattern。
只有一次，和 weekly sequence 不符。

exercises.original: The researchers identified a rising trend in stress levels as exam season approached.
exercises.zh: 隨著考試季節臨近，研究人員發現壓力水平呈上升模式。
exercises.upgrade: The researchers identified a rising pattern in stress levels as exam season approached.

options.explanation: as exam season approached 表示時間逐步推進，而 stress levels 隨之增加，形成 rising pattern。
只是一個突然高點，不表示隨考試季接近逐步上升。

falseSynonyms.zh: 增加 ≠ 一定是趨勢 一次 increase 不代表 trend。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An increase can happen once. A rising trend means the general direction is upward across time or repeated observations.

falseSynonyms.zh: 高峰 ≠ 上升趨勢 peak 是最高點；rising trend 是到達高點之前或一段期間的上升方向。
波動 ≠ 上升 fluctuation 表示上下變動，不一定有整體向上方向。
穩定趨勢 ≠ 上升趨勢 stable 表示大致不變，和 rising 相反。
下降趨勢 ≠ 上升趨勢 declining / downward trend 是反義概念。
增長 ≠ trend 本身 growth 表示增長這個現象或數量增加；trend 則包含時間方向。
焦點不同 - trend = 通常可由資料／時間序列觀察 - tendency = 更常表示人或現象的傾向
名詞／動詞 vs 形容詞 詞性和句法不同。
falseSynonyms.point: - a rise in prices - prices rise - a rising trend
